signal_definitions.I: Insider open-market purchase (Form 4, last 90 days, excludes option exercises)

methodology_notes: 2026-10-27 v1: Initial weights set per Buffett/Gross value philosophy — valuation-heavy (0.35) with strong quality emphasis (0.30). Signals at 0.15 reflecting high predictive evidence from academic literature on insider buying. Technical dip (0.05) kept minimal as dip alone is not a value signal.

weight_update_policy.note: Blackout months are earnings seasons (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct) where broad market noise drowns out factor signals.
